record.field: Extraction (Simple)
Tooth pain / request for removal
Patient reports pain for [duration]. Previous treatments: [none/filling/RCT]. Medical history reviewed.
Extra-oral: No swelling / lymphadenopathy. Intra-oral: Tooth [#] — [caries/fracture/mobility grade]. Periapical radiograph reviewed.
Unrestorable tooth / periapical pathology requiring extraction.
Informed consent obtained. Local anaesthesia administered ([agent] [dose]). Tooth extracted atraumatically. Socket irrigated and compressed. Haemostasis achieved. Post-op instructions given.
Next visit in [1 week] for socket review if needed. Prescribed: [analgesics/antibiotics as indicated].
Composite Filling
Cavity / tooth sensitivity / chipped tooth
Patient reports sensitivity to [cold/sweet/biting] for [duration]. No spontaneous pain.
Tooth [#] surface [M/O/D/B/L]: caries [depth: enamel/dentine/near pulp]. Vitality test: [positive/negative]. Radiograph: no periapical pathology.
Dentinal caries tooth [#] — composite restoration indicated.
LA administered. Rubber dam placed. Caries excavated. Liner placed [if deep]. Composite resin [shade] placed in increments. Light-cured. Occlusion adjusted. Polish completed.
Patient advised to avoid hard foods for 24 h. Return if sensitivity persists beyond 2 weeks.
Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
Severe / spontaneous toothache or abscess
Patient reports [spontaneous / night / severe] pain for [duration]. Previous: [analgesics / antibiotics]. Swelling: [present/absent].
Tooth [#]: tender to percussion [yes/no], palpation [yes/no]. Vitality: [absent/necrotic]. Radiograph: widened PDL / periapical radiolucency [size].
Pulp necrosis / irreversible pulpitis / periapical abscess — RCT indicated.

Informed consent. LA administered. Rubber dam. Access cavity prepared. Working length determined (apex locator + radiograph: [mm]). Canals [n] instrumented to [size] with [rotary system]. Irrigation [NaOCl / EDTA / CHX]. Canals dried and [obturated with GP/Ca(OH)₂ dressing placed]. Temporary restoration placed.
Review in [1 week]. Crown placement recommended after RCT completion.
Crown Preparation
Broken / heavily restored tooth requiring full coverage
Tooth [#] — [post-RCT / large existing restoration / fracture]. Patient agrees to crown.
Tooth [#]: [adequate ferrule / bone levels adequate]. Existing restoration [type]. Gingival health [satisfactory].
Tooth requires full-coverage crown — [PFM / Zirconia / E.max].

LA administered. Tooth prepared: [chamfer / shoulder] margin [supra/equi/sub-gingival]. Retraction cord placed. Digital or alginate impression taken. Temporary crown placed with [temp cement]. Shade [shade] recorded. Lab Rx sent.
Crown delivery appointment scheduled in [2 weeks]. Patient advised on temp crown care.

Plaque score: [%]. Calculus: supra [mild/mod/heavy], sub [present/absent]. BPE score: [codes per sextant]. Gingival condition: [inflamed/healthy].
Gingivitis / periodontitis stage [I/II/III/IV] — scaling and polishing indicated.

Full-mouth supragingival scaling with ultrasonic and hand instruments. Subgingival debridement [sextants]. Polish with prophy paste. Oral hygiene instruction: [Bass technique / TePe / floss]. Fluoride varnish applied [if indicated].
Recall in [6 months]. Review [if perio pocket >4 mm: book perio assessment].
